Scream Ghost Face Voiceover

My chilling Ghost Face male voiceover, inspired by horror icon Rodger Jackson, is ideal for Halloween ads, promos, and theme park events...

‹›

Classic horror. Killer delivery.

The iconic 'Ghost Face' scream from the Scream films is unforgettable, and it’s all thanks to Rodger Jackson, the voice actor behind the mask. I’ve crafted a chilling tribute to his tone, ideal for horror movie trailers, theme park promos, or anything needing a blood-curdling scream. It’s just one of many evil voiceovers in my Halloween collection.

Scream Ghost Face Voiceover

A haunted collection of scary voices

Alongside this Ghost Face scream, I offer an entire crypt of creepy characters. Try my Count Dracula, Joker-style, or spooky Halloween laughs. These eerie voiceovers are perfect for everything from game trailers and haunted attractions to theme park events like Alton Towers Scarefest.

Want this voice in your next horror project?

Whether you’re working on a TV commercial, game trailer, or Halloween park announcement – I can record your scream-style voiceover fast. My studio delivers broadcast-quality audio with same-day turnaround in most cases. Need it urgently? Get in touch.

Want this scary voice for your project?

If you're working on a Halloween commercial, a spooky narration, or just want to give your content a scary edge, let's chat. I usually turn work around same-day, even during fright season.
